subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

A. Some bakeries are outlet showrooms.

B. All outlet showrooms are shops.

**Conclusion:**

1. Some shops are bakeries as well as outlet showrooms.

2. All bakeries are shops.
solution:
**Given:**

**Statements:**

A. Some bakeries are outlet showrooms.

B. All outlet showrooms are shops.

The least possible diagram for the given statements is as follows

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/328362eb06f7ce795e33164afd57c5f32dc7587cd3557d3e8fed911ec72c8885.png] 

**Conclusion:**

1. Some shops are bakeries as well as outlet showrooms → True (Because all outlet showrooms are Shops and some bakeries are outlet showrooms so definitely some shops are bakeries as well as outlet showrooms )

2. All bakeries are shops → False (It is possible but not definite)

Hence, the **Only conclusion I follow.**
